cost_note: actual_usd uses priced token usage for live responses and conservative bounds for failed or usage-missing attempts; it is not an independently reconciled provider invoice.
cutoff_note: Top-3/5/10 are prefixes of the same predicted ordering; each oracle uses the full eligible universe.
label_source: existing frozen market high/low; no open/close substitution
partial_label_note: Partial sessions are flagged and scored on the labelled eligible universe; missing selected rank positions contribute zero. Each mean reports its denominator.
replication_scope: Policy/replicate trajectories have isolated memory and replicate-scoped response caches; exact requests may share cache only within a replicate.

integrity.measurement_note: Resolution means an accepted evidence card, not realised-event truth. Unsupported observations are verifier rejection proxies; latency sums model attempts, not wall time.
